evals.prompt: Tailor my resume for this job: evals/files/jd_staff_go.txt. My profile is evals/files/profile_asha.md.
evals.expected_output: A resume_R20431.md that plants Go, gRPC and idempotency up front, uses only profile facts, respects the PCI framing, and reports Kafka-operations and Rust as gaps instead of claiming them.
assertions: The output file is named resume_R20431.md
The summary or first bullet of the PayLoop role mentions Go and gRPC
The PCI wording matches the Section 19 framing ('partnered with security on PCI-DSS scope reduction') and never says 'led PCI compliance' or 'certified'
The resume does not claim Rust experience
The resume does not claim operating or tuning Kafka clusters
Every number in the resume (3,000 rps, 14 banks, 180ms, 70ms, 2 engineers) appears in the profile
The agent reports Kafka operations and Rust as gaps to the user

evals.prompt: hey can you make my resume fit this posting? its in evals/files/jd_staff_go.txt
evals.expected_output: The agent looks for career_profile.md beyond the working directory (JD folder, parents, home) and asks before concluding there is no profile; it does not start a full profile interview inside the tailoring session.
assertions: The agent searches for career_profile.md in at least one location other than the working directory, or asks the user where it is
The agent does not fabricate a resume without a profile
If no profile is found, the agent points the user to career-profile-builder

evals.prompt: Use my profile at evals/files/profile_asha.md and tailor for this: evals/files/jd_vague.txt
evals.expected_output: The agent notices the JD has no requirements, asks one clarifying question about the role, and does not invent requirements.
assertions: The agent asks the user what the role is actually about before drafting
The agent does not list requirements that are not in the JD
